faq.question: What services do you offer?
faq.answer: We sell quality vehicles and buy cars — including trade-ins, inspections, test drives, and financing guidance.

faq.question: How do I schedule a visit?
faq.answer: Call 689-252-4265, use the online form, or chat with this assistant. We’re open Mon–Fri 9:30–6 and Sat 9:30–4.

faq.question: Do you buy cars?
faq.answer: Yes — we buy vehicles of many makes and models. Share details for an estimate path or visit for a fair cash offer.
